2121021636103286855.en_summary: $RKLB - Rocket Lab Set for Historic 100th Electron Launch on November 14. Electron poised to become the fastest commercially developed rocket to reach 100 launches, less than a decade after 2017 debut. Launch scheduled for November 14 at 6:30 p.m. NZDT from Mahia, New Zealand. Mission deploys Earth-imaging satellite for Japanese company iQPS.
2121021636103286855.zh_summary: $RKLB - Rocket Lab 準備於 11 月 14 日進行歷史性的第 100 次 Electron 發射。Electron 有望成為商業開發火箭中最快達到 100 次發射的，自 2017 年首次亮相不到十年。發射定於 11 月 14 日下午 6:30 NZDT 從新西蘭 Mahia 進行。任務為日本公司 iQPS 部署地球成像衛星。
